businessGoal: Allow visitors to view full details of a product.

scenarios.goal: Verify that all product information (image, name, description, price, category badge, brand badge) is displayed on the product detail page.
Verify that the section with related products is shown below the main product information on the product detail page.
Verify that each related product is clickable and navigates to its respective detail page.

manual.reason: Functional story requires manual verification of UI elements and interactions.

api.reason: The story does not mention API capabilities related to product details.

ui.reason: The acceptance criteria describe visible browser behavior and page content.
